rule_level_problems.rule: Diagnose possible threatened/complete miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy, incomplete/inevitable miscarriage
rule_level_problems.problem: Page's 'likely' conclusions for the early-pregnancy branch are encoded as possible, not probable (threatened, complete, incomplete, inevitable). The evidence is all in the miscarriage check_for, so probable would pass the tests.

The < 22 weeks gate is lost (not representable) and nothing distinguishes the late-pregnancy >= 22 weeks branch, so every pregnant woman with vaginal bleeding and no os/POC findings (including a third-trimester antepartum haemorrhage) gets threatened miscarriage, complete miscarriage and ectopic pregnancy all at once. Threatened, complete and ectopic share identical evidence.

summary: The red-box triage is encoded faithfully (all 12 danger signs in the Urgent rule, with correct BP thresholds and pre-eclampsia/PROM/preterm-labour diagnoses). The main problems: the early-pregnancy branch's 'miscarriage likely' conclusions are encoded as possible instead of probable, and with no gestation gate they fire for any vaginal bleed. Preterm labour fires at term. Eclampsia, shock (footnote 1) and chorioamnionitis (footnote 4) have no rules.
